data.description: LHA Car and Commercial Garage based in Rothwell, Leeds. Providing servicing, car repairs, MOTs, Tyres, exhausts, batteries, electric cars and more.

chunks.text: Great prices on our hassle free MOT tests
The Future is Electric… The Future is Here!
But who can you trust to service your electric car?
and let us sort all your motoring needs, domestic and commercial !

I booked an MOT and had to change the date at the last minute. I got a lovely reply even on a Sunday to say that would be ok. Rebooked without any problems. Great service, really friendly staff. Will definitely be back for future MOTs and services :)
Just fill in as much information as you can below, but don’t worry if you’re not sure what to put!
As long as we’ve got your contact details, one of our friendly team can call you to get anything else we need!

We can offer you a full range of services for your car or commercial vehicle, including MOT, servicing, repairs (including tyres, exhaust, brakes, batteries, clutches and full diagnostics). Read below to find out more about LHA Car and Commercial Garage in Rothwell, Leeds.
Starting from just £35 (45% off the normal MOT charge elsewhere in Leeds) LHA is the perfect choice for your MOT in Rothwell, Leeds and right across West Yorkshire.

We know your time is precious, so every part of the MOT process exists to make it easy for you and all our testers, mechanics and other members of staff are trained to a high level in customer service and satisfaction.
Our experienced technicians and testers allow us to complete your MOT test speedily without compromising on safety in any way. We will always try to complete your test in under an hour.
We can supply and fit new tyres on site, same day service or while you wait. Just get in touch and we’ll find you premium, mid-price of budget options for your car.

Our mechanics will check, repair or replace your exhaust system, in full or part as required. You can trust L.H.A. for an honest, reliable and professional repair. Just call us on 0113 288 9777 or click here to contact us.

Whether your car needs new brake pads and/or discs, our mechanics will assess you car and car out only the necessary work. We’ll have your motor stopping on a sixpence in no time! Just get in touch today to book your appointment.
From cars to commercial vehicles, we can supply and fit batteries to your vehicle. Give us a call and we’ll get you back on the road in no time.

We can offer complete diagnostics and repairs for vehicles of all makes and models. Our technical knowledge and cutting edge equipment means we can provide an unrivalled service. Give us a call or get in touch to discuss your needs.

Got a gearbox or clutch problem? We’ll be able to diagnose the problem and advise you on sorting the problem and getting you back on the road. Call us today or use our contact form and we’ll get you back into gear!

L.H.A. will keep you cool during the summer months and make sure your windows are clear and demisted on those cold mornings! Remember, a well-maintained air conditioning system is essential for your comfort and safety.
We can make sure yours is working to perfection, so just call us to book your car in or click here for our online contact form.
Commercial vehicle and van repairs can be a headache, but L.H.A. are here to help.

Our skilled commercial mechanics are fully trained to diagnose and repair your commercial vehicle and all our work is carried out on an upfront quotation basis, meaning you are always aware of costs before we undertake any work.
We also work with many approved partners to carry out accident repair work, so you can be safe in the knowledge that we only ever use trusted partners who we trust.
For all commercial work and/or accident repair work, just get in touch by calling 0113 288 9777 or click here to contact us.
We are conveniently based in Rothwell, Leeds and are dedicated to providing a quality service to our customers old and new.
We’re really proud that L.H.A. are a family run business and we strive for excellent customer service every time.
Established in 2006, Mark and Pauline (and the team) took over the running of L.H.A. in November 2015 and have taken the business from strength to strength.
The L.H.A. ‘family’ are a very important part of everything we do and we pride ourselves on having a strong and dedicated team to ensure the services we provide is second to none.
Please take a look at the services we provide.
